scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test:domain --workspace=frontend && npm run test:ferias-relatorio --workspace=frontend && npm run test:ordens-servico --workspace=frontend && npm run test:exercicios && npm run test:ptrba-apoc && npm run test:auditoria && npm run test:storage
scripts.test:deploy: npm run test:domain --workspace=frontend && npm run test:ferias-relatorio --workspace=frontend && npm run test:ordens-servico --workspace=frontend && npm run test:exercicios && npm run test:auditoria && npm run test:storage && npm run test:cadastro-pessoas
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:deploy && npm run build
scripts.test:exercicios: npm run build --workspace=backend && node backend/scripts/exercicios-number.test.mjs && npm run test:exercicios --workspace=frontend
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm backend npm run db:migrate
